adapter-entry-points.method: Accepted Workspace CLI Capability validation and clean staged Codex Provider Entry Point generation

governed-dependency-composition.method: Repository contract tests require immutable Registry Lock resolution of portfolio-snapshot and options-vol-analysis, complete dependency-result preservation, options persist=false, and no connector-era substitute

observable-analysis-equivalence.method: Repository tests normalize the exact Claude and Codex adapters to identical semantics and bind the same grounded snapshot, portfolio observation, ordered options result, quote-unavailability, freshness, limitation, and zero-write requirements to a digest-bound representative fixture; no live provider invocation is claimed

read-only-authority-boundary.method: Compared the exact Codex adapter with issue #65, accepted parent #46 and blockers #47/#64, the connector-era portfolio-analysis intent, and current Trade Journal and Radon authority boundaries

dependency-unavailability.method: Exact-adapter tests require snapshot failure to stop options invocation and require options refusal, unavailability, or failure to produce a partial zero-write result; current accepted dependency evidence separately covers the eligible portfolio database and options data environments
